source: Original fictional songs and seeded synthetic playlist sessions
split: 48 train / 9 validation / 12 test sessions; hold out final song in validation/test; entire held-out sessions excluded from co-occurrence fitting
leakagePolicy: Vocabulary comes from catalog, not held-out interactions. Popularity uses train only. Queries exclude already observed songs. Song sets are unique across all sessions/splits. Synthetic themes remain intentionally easy and are not real listening behavior.
